description: List committees for a jurisdiction. jurisdiction is required — a request spanning all 56 jurisdictions exceeds the upstream timeout, so scope every call to a single state; use openstates_list_jurisdictions to pick one. Experimental — Open States is actively working to restore committee support and not all states have data. Use chamber to scope to upper (senate) or lower (house) committees. Use classification=subcommittee to find subcommittees of a parent. Use include=memberships to get the full roster with member roles. The coverageNote field in the output will always note the experimental coverage limitations.

chamber.description: Filter by chamber. "upper" = Senate, "lower" = House/Assembly. A chamber filter omits joint committees; omit chamber to include them.

classification.description: Filter to parent committees or subcommittees only. Omit for all.

include.description: Related data to inline. "memberships" includes the full roster with member roles. "links" includes the committee homepage and reference links, and "sources" the provenance URLs behind the record.

jurisdiction.description: State name, abbreviation, or OCD-ID. Required — an all-states request exceeds the upstream timeout, so every call must be scoped to a single jurisdiction.

parent.description: OCD organization ID of a parent committee to retrieve its subcommittees.

name: openstates_search_committees

appliedFilters.description: Filters applied to this query as the server received them, for agent self-verification of zero or unexpected results.

coverageNote.description: Committee data is experimental — not all states have coverage in Open States. Empty results may indicate the state lacks data, not that no committees exist.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_timeout`: Open States did not answer within the per-request timeout — the query is too broad. `invalid_page`: Open States rejected the request as not found — page is past the last page for this query. `rate_limited`: The shared Open States API key reached a request cap — Open States' per-minute or daily limit, or this server's own daily budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

id.description: OCD organization ID — use as committee_id in openstates_get_committee.

links.description: Committee homepage and reference links when include=links is requested.

note.description: Link description (e.g., "homepage"). Empty string when Open States recorded no description.

memberships.description: Membership roster when include=memberships is requested.

person_id.description: OCD person ID of the member — pass it to openstates_search_people as id for the full record. Empty string when the membership carries no linked person.

person_name.description: Member name. Empty string when Open States recorded none.

role.description: Member role (e.g., "chair", "member"). Empty string when Open States recorded none.

parent_id.description: OCD ID of parent committee, or null for top-level committees.

sources.description: Provenance sources when include=sources is requested.

note.description: Source note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

totalCount.description: Total committees matching the query across all pages.

title: Search Committees
